findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 372 requests to 103 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 4.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.5 MB (73%) came from third-party domains, 1.6 MB of it from services classified as tracking (278 requests).

67 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising).
177 cookies were set by third-party domains (225 cookies in total).
